g.text: • Pivot the extracted URLs/domains in VirusTotal, URLhaus and your passive DNS. Pull the staged
payload in an isolated VM, not on a host.
• Decode the PowerShell: base64 -d the -enc blob, then deobfuscate the download cradle to
• Cross-reference the SHA256 against MalwareBazaar / your internal corpus before writing it up -
you may already have the family and C2.
